name: Lago

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED, and it is the only asymmetric-by-default scheme in the cluster. Headers `X-Lago-Signature` and `X-Lago-Signature-Algorithm`. Two algorithms selectable at endpoint creation: JWT (the default, RS256, verified against a public key fetched once from Lago's webhooks API and cached — issuer `https://api.getlago.com` for cloud) or HMAC. Because RS256 verification needs a fetched-and-persisted public key, the generated code needs a key-cache step that no other provider in PagoKit requires. Self-hosted instances generate their own JWT RSA keys on first deployment, so the issuer and key source

fees.notes: Open source core is free (self-hosted). Cloud pricing UNKNOWN — not verified.

notes: Open-source, self-hostable metered billing — the only option here where usage data (which for an AI company is customer prompt volume) never leaves the developer's infrastructure. That is a hard requirement for regulated and EU-privacy-sensitive customers, and PagoKit has no self-hostable option in any category.
SDKs: Official Node `lago-javascript-client`, Python `lago-python-client`, PHP `getlago/lago-php-client`, plus Ruby/Go/Java. Docker/Helm for self-hosting.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
